name: Thabo Dlamini
bio:
Thabo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. After a successful career in corporate marketing for a major telecommunications firm, he attended a local rally event with a friend and was instantly captivated by the energy and passion. He quickly realized that his skills in branding and audience engagement could translate well to the world of racing. He started volunteering with a smaller racing team, handling their social media and promotional events, eventually gaining the experience and connections needed to land his current role at JOTA Sport.

As a marketing coordinator, Thabo focuses on building brand awareness and fan engagement for the team. He is a strong believer in data-driven marketing, carefully analyzing metrics to optimize campaign performance and target the right audiences. Thabo is known for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to craft compelling narratives that resonate with fans, sponsors, and the media alike. His perfectionism ensures that every aspect of the team's marketing efforts is polished and professional, contributing to JOTA Sport's image as a top-tier racing organization.

physical.description: Thabo has a warm smile and a sturdy build, suggesting a life of both intellectual and physical activity.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down marketing ideas, even in meetings.
Insists on using a specific brand of pens for signing important documents.
Has a habit of pacing while on phone calls, often covering several kilometers in a day.
